Ieobom final Tripo female presentation shell

The retained Tripo asset is the project owner's single-front-image female
presentation model, locally prepared as the exterior shell for the final
Triangle 2M + Z-Anatomy comparison.

Retained runtime derivatives:

- The v15 exterior shell with the approved head, hand, foot, relaxed-arm, and
  reduced-foot-shell presentation adjustments.
- The matching adaptive surface-flow guide.
- The matching cleaned regional-boundary guide.

The generated shell and guides are visual presentation assets. They are not
medically validated, diagnostic, or patient-specific anatomy. The project must
confirm the applicable Tripo plan and asset-usage terms before redistribution
outside the development prototype.

Holographic color, transparency, wireframe, and glow are applied at runtime by
the Ieobom Three.js viewer and are not baked into the source GLB.
